notes:
Summary: Enterprise contact-center provider exploring Redwood to replace prototype stack (in-house retriever + 3rd-party API). Main goals: accurate RAG with verifiable citations, near-real-time freshness on KB, deterministic fallbacks during spikes, and secure private deployment.

Key constraints/asks:
- Must support VPC/private control plane; plan to host Dedicated in their GCP projects or on-prem appliance for PII lanes.
- Data residency: EU for EU customers; want configurable sharding by region.
- Strong audit logs and retention controls; legal requires 7-year audit trail for escalations.
- SSO via SAML with IdP metadata; SCIM for provisioning preferred.
- Tool-calling: need out-of-the-box connector for Salesforce Service Cloud + webhook-based adapters for legacy dialer.
- Throughput target: 500 concurrent live agents during peak; spike profile up to 2.5x sustained for 1 hour. Latency SLO: median <200ms agent assist, p95 <600ms.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to pay for predictable reserved capacity if unit cost reduction >=25% vs current cloud.

POC details & metrics observed so far:
- Data ingested: ticket history (18mo), KB articles (internal + community), Slack transcripts, policy PDFs (ocr-ed).
- Retrieval setup: hybrid dense+BM25 index per region, L2 ANN for embeddings (Faiss). Custom citation scoring added by SE.
- Preliminary evaluation: recall@5 0.78, precision of cited passages ~0.72 (needs improvement on policy docs).
- Freshness pipeline: CDC from support DB every 15m; initial delta ingestion had 3-5m lag. Ops wants <=2m for high-priority docs.
- Reliability tests: single-region dedicated nodes held 500 concurrent agents steady; observed cold-start spike caused degraded qps at 2.2x load — need autoscale policy + cross-region fallback.

Stakeholder quotes & shorthand:
- Head of Support (Marta Rivera): "Need the agent to be confident — show source, timestamp, and confidence score."
- CTO (Anand Rao): "No external PII leave. Private control plane required for enterprise clients."
- Contact center ops: "Tool-calls must never duplicate tickets on retry. Idempotency required."

Next steps (short):
- SE to run 24h spike POC (Wed 2025-03-05) with canary cross-region fallback enabled.
- Security to receive DPA + KMS design doc; Legal to review by 2025-03-12.
- Map Salesforce field sync and confirm idempotent tool-calling contract.
